overview.title: Research Framework
overview.body: Research for Envue was organized around a clear relationship between source material, design decisions, and project outcomes. Each annotation summarizes the source, evaluates its credibility and limitations, and explains how the research informed the development of the Envue brand identity.

steps.title: Research Source
steps.body: Books, UX articles, and fashion-related research that informed Envue’s development.

steps.title: Design Decision
steps.body: The specific strategic, visual, typographic, experiential, or system-level choice shaped by the research.

steps.title: Envue Artifact
steps.body: The final Envue deliverable, system, interaction pattern, content structure, or presentation element where research influence is ultimately reflected.

bibliography.title: Annotated Sources
bibliography.body: This research phase connects Envue’s major design decisions to thirteen selected sources spanning brand strategy, identity design, typography, visual systems, user experience, and sustainability research. Together, these sources informed the brand strategy, identity standards, emotional tone, typography, visual system, logo refinement, sustainability context, and user experience principles behind the project.
